description.p: RustTracker is a high-performance, real-time audio visualizer, video player, and tracker module player built in Rust with Vulkan/WGPU hardware acceleration.

It features over 24 cinematic compute and fragment shader visualizers (Ferrofluid, 3D Fire, Synthwave Racer, CRT Oscilloscope, Bioluminescence, and more), low-latency 3-thread DSP architecture, support for classic tracker modules (.MOD, .XM, .S3M, .IT), lossless and compressed audio (FLAC, MP3, WAV, OGG, Opus), multi-track video playback, and real-time lyrics synchronization.

Windows WASAPI Exclusive mode playback stability enhancements, zero-masked 24-in-32 bit PCM DAC screeching elimination, synchronized multi-channel visualizer dispatch, Retro Tape Head aspect-ratio adaptation, and macOS build fixes.

Fix visualizer DSP audio pipeline in multi-channel LPCM and bitstream modes: restore lookahead waveform timeline for Retro Tape Head, multi-channel downmix for CRT oscilloscope, peak VU tracking for Chrome Ferrofluid spikes and analog meters, and 60 Hz DSP rate alignment.
Windows multi-channel LPCM exclusive mode audio streaming (5.1 / 7.1 surround for FLAC, ALAC, PCM), automatic AV receiver / HDMI endpoint matching, and visualizer DSP pipeline synchronization.
Comprehensive desktop integration release with single-instance IPC, recursive folder loading, hicolor icon hierarchy, and power management improvements.
